text: Oh, say can you see by the dawn's early light What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming? Who saw stripes and bright stars from the perilous fight? Or the rockets we watched were so gallantly streaming? And the rockets red glare, the bombs bursting in air, Came flying through the night, that the flag was still there. Oh, say does that star-spangled banner yet wave? O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave?
